title: fysio.care clinic discovery
description: Discover Swedish MSK clinics on fysio.care: search clinics, services, and open appointment times.
summary: Discover Swedish MSK clinics on fysio.care: search clinics, services, and open appointment times.
offersHint: Discover Swedish MSK clinics on fysio.care: search clinics, services, and open appointment times. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://fysio.care/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_clinics
toolsPreview.description: Search the public directory of Swedish MSK clinics (fysioterapi, naprapati, kiropraktik m.fl.) on fysio.care. Returns published clinics with FHIR Organization resources. Use list_clinic_services next to see what a clinic offers.

toolsPreview.name: list_clinic_services
toolsPreview.description: List the bookable services of one clinic, with duration, price (SEK) and a FHIR HealthcareService per bookable variant. The variant id is what get_available_slots takes.

toolsPreview.name: get_available_slots
toolsPreview.description: Free appointment slots for one bookable service variant at one clinic, up to 14 days ahead. Each slot carries a FHIR Slot resource and a bookingUrl where the PATIENT completes the booking themselves on the web (this server never books).

toolsPreview.name: get_next_available_date
toolsPreview.description: Earliest free slot for a service variant, scanning up to 90 days ahead. Use when get_available_slots comes back empty.
